task_completion.description: Set location to ALMA observatory in Chile with specific coordinates and altitude.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Location window in Stellarium showing 'ALMA' or coordinates near 23.019° S, 67.753° W and altitude 5050m.

task_completion.description: Set simulation time to July 15, 2024, at 03:00 UTC.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Date/Time window or the status bar at the bottom showing 2024-07-15 and 03:00:00.

task_completion.description: Disable atmosphere and landscape; enable Galactic Grid and Galactic Equator.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The sky view should have no ground/horizon and no blue atmospheric glow. A coordinate grid (Galactic) and a line for the Galactic Equator must be visible.

task_completion.description: Save the configuration so settings persist.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save settings' button being clicked in the Configuration window.

task_completion.description: Locate and center the view on the constellation Sagittarius.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Search window showing 'Sagittarius' and the main view centered on the constellation with a selection pointer/label on it.

task_completion.description: Save a screenshot to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window or terminal output showing a new image file in ~/Pictures/stellarium/.

task_completion.description: Write a note to ~/Desktop/galactic_survey_plan.txt with required keywords.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command output showing the file content containing 'Sagittarius', 'ALMA', and 'July 15'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Stellarium GUI to configure settings rather than just editing config files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with Stellarium's sidebars and dialog windows (Location, Date/Time, Search).

integrity.description: The visual state of the sky matches the requested coordinates and time.
integrity.visual_evidence: The stars and galactic plane position in the screenshot correspond to the Chilean sky at the specified UTC time.

integrity.description: The agent created the observation note during the session.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent typing in a text editor or using a redirect command to create the .txt file.
